answer: Linkage clustering: each epoch a 'reef' of 5 random established graders checks every pair of new keys for shared IP /24, a shared funding wallet, and answers sent within 2s. Pairs hitting all 3 merge into one 'juniper' cluster sharing a single reward slot, so 1,000 fakes on one host earn what 1 honest node does; 1,000 rewards need 1,000 hosts, wallets and schedules, ~1,000x the cost. A new key's first 10 epochs are its 'voyage', paid only once the reef clears it. Weakness: proxies hide IPs. Fix: swap the IP test for funding-graph distance under 3 hops.
